title: Animated report card
description: A clip of a measured result (a gate run, a bake-off, a wave's counts) from a receipt or report JSON: every number on screen comes from that file.

body.subject: The result in {{data_source}}: {{headline}}; the fields shown are {{fields}}.
body.action: The title sets; each number counts up to its exact value or each bar grows to it, one at a time, with its label and unit; pass and fail marks appear after their numbers; the full card holds for at least 2 s at the end.
body.style: Night surface; numbers in the site's mono; pass in the go colour, fail in the stop colour, a warning in flame, shape first and colour second (a tick, a cross, a dot); {{palette}}.
body.constraints: Write ONE scene folder: an HTML entry plus its JS, CSS, fonts and images, nothing fetched from elsewhere. Expose window.__scene = {duration_s, width, height}, an async window.__setup() that loads every font and decodes every image and reports each one, window.__frame(t) that sets EVERY animated property from t (seconds) alone, and window.__audit() that lists the visible text with its box, size and colour. No Date, performance.now, Math.random, requestAnimationFrame, CSS animations or CSS transitions: easing and any flicker are closed-form functions of t. All text inside the 5% title-safe area, at least {{min_text_px}} px tall at the output size, with contrast of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24 px and up). No text over a busy image without a plate behind it. Read the numbers from the data file at build time and print them exactly as the file states them (no rounding beyond the file's own precision); a count-up ends on the exact value for at least 1 s; name the source file and its date on the card.

min_text_px.description: the smallest text at the output size; the self-check fails under 22

palette.default: the brand's own tokens from the supplied stylesheet
palette.description: where the colours come from; never invented

data_source.description: project-relative path of the receipt or report JSON

headline.description: one line saying what was measured

fields.description: comma-separated JSON paths of the numbers to show

negatives: no number that is not in the data file
no colour as the only signal of pass or fail

gates.description: requests other than file: and data: during the render (the scene must be self-contained)
sampled frame with no visible mark: share of pixels carrying a local luminance step
warning only: a nearly empty sampled frame (a weak poster frame)
visible text box outside the 5% title-safe margin
measured contrast of fully visible authored text against the pixels around it (3.0 at 24 px and up)
authored text overlapping a figure or card box
frames differing when the receipt is re-rendered by verify (same engine, sequential order)
